cores.name: Jarvis Screen
cores.description: JARVIS SCREEN: a full-screen Iron-Man style display controlled by Hydra. Generative card UI (text/web/YouTube/HA climate/camera), arc reactor that pulses with TTS audio, per-screen unlock methods (Tater Face ID camera scan, tap-to-unlock, or a 4-digit PIN) with optional per-screen access-denied / access-granted voices, per-screen profiles, in-browser voice input (tap-to-talk, 'hey jarvis' wake word, follow-up conversations, photo-based Face ID enrollment, the per-screen face allowlist as the unlock gate, per-screen layout sets (which layouts a screen offers, in nav order), a visual layout editor ('Edit Layout on Screen': drag/resize cards on a live screen, saved as per-screen card placements over the layout's base geometry), a Screens manager tab to add/manage screen profiles, a Cards manager tab to add/manage cards from built-in templates (JARVIS chat, web browser, YouTube, camera, ...) plus UniFi Protect + Home Assistant entity pickers, and (optionally in settings) the person a screen was face-unlocked by reported to the LLM on that screen's voice turns until it locks again).
